cover_letter:
Dear Stryker Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education position within your Peripheral Vascular division in EMEA.

What draws me to this role is the translation work at its centre: taking clinical evidence and turning it into content and training that sales teams and healthcare professionals can genuinely use. That is close to what I do daily. As a junior digital marketer at Episto I write SEO content for client websites, manage pages and blog posts in WordPress and Shopify, and track results in Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Analytics. Alongside that I run my own freelance practice, building sites, structured data and AI-search visibility. A large part of the work is making complicated material clear — and making sure it is right before anyone else reads it.

Healthcare is not unfamiliar ground. At ViviDoctor in Belgium I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application, and I saw how much care goes into presenting clinical information responsibly. I would like to bring that mindset, plus my marketing and web skills, to a mission like Stryker's.

Organisation is the other half of this job, and it is the half I enjoy. Freelancing while holding a marketing role means I plan my own weeks, keep multiple client projects moving and respond to client questions without letting anything slip. At Knowledge Experts I supported the team building internal platforms for companies with thousands of employees, where following process and coordinating with other people mattered as much as the build itself.

Languages help in an EMEA role based in Belgium: fluent English, native Turkish, and Dutch I'm actively improving (writing B1, speaking A2+). I'm happy to travel 60% and eager to learn the products and therapies properly.

I would welcome the chance to talk.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
